clips.start_words: When you release and let go
clips.end_words: when things manifest in your life
clips.send: Someone who just blew a big opportunity by trying too hard sends this to a friend gripping too tight on a goal, proof that loosening the grip is what actually lets it land.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau borrows a line from Herb Cohen, the legendary Chicago negotiator, to explain why wanting something too badly is exactly what keeps it away.

Cohen's rule for negotiation and life: you have to care, but not that much.

The moment you release your grip on how a goal has to turn out, Kevin says, you stop broadcasting lack and start broadcasting abundance. That shift is what actually opens the door.

Hold the goal. Feel like you already have it. Then let go of needing it to happen on any particular timeline.

What are you gripping so tightly that it cannot come to you?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #mindsetshift #yourwishisyourcommand #mindovermatter

clips.send: Someone who just caught themselves being short with a stranger sends this to a friend having a rough week, proof that a silent kindness comes back multiplied.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau teaches a technique so simple most people dismiss it: silently say "I love you" to every person you pass, without ever saying it out loud.

He calls it making a deposit. Send the feeling out first, before anyone gives you a reason to, and the universe sends it back multiplied - a hundred times, even a thousand times over, he says.

It costs nothing and takes no time. You can do it waiting in line, driving to work, walking down the street.

Compassion, Kevin says, is simply believing the person in front of you deserves to be happy too.

What would change if you quietly blessed the next ten strangers you passed?

#kevintrudeau #lawofattraction #manifestation #gratitude #yourwishisyourcommand #mindsetshift
